goal: Ensure wallet fee-bumped transactions do not get an earlier locktime than the original transaction
Eliminate an unnatural on-chain pattern that fingerprints Bitcoin Core wallet replacements
agreement: Support on concept and approach with tested ACKs on earlier revisions (nervana21, molnard)
Contested mocktime restoration in tests with ACK withheld pending test updates (polespinasa)
Contested suggestion to place locktime logic inside the anti-fee-sniping check (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it eliminates an on-chain fingerprinting pattern caused by anti-fee-sniping locktime rollbacks
Benefit is marginal as the backdating pattern occurs in under two percent of replacements
